findings.issue: Fix lane 1 justifies the Claude executor as 'scripts/aws/** ... EventBridge infra is Claude-owned by the brief's lane rule', but scripts/aws/** is not in queue.mjs GOVERNANCE_PATHS and validateLane/scope-check would not reject a kiro lane over it. The real, sufficient reason is that a Kiro lane may never make the mutating AWS call that applies the EventBridge change (collaboration §7a).
findings.fix: Reword the lane-1 parenthetical to lead with the §7a 'no mutating AWS call' reason instead of implying a governance-path match that does not exist. Executor assignment (claude) is correct regardless.
